purpose: Teach: プログラマー/ユーティリティ/短大/本学/南側/伝送/陳列/懲戒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、プログラマーの仕事も経験しろ
lines.en: Ren — get experience working as a programmer too.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Calm authority. No question mark, just expectation. Lean forward slightly on the name. Brief pause after the name before the assignment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室のユーティリティを使いこなします
lines.en: Yes. I'll master the lab utilities.
lines.style: Quick, respectful affirmation. Eager but controlled — not overselling. Slight straighten in posture. Clear syllables, no waver. Genuine commitment underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、短大教員の研究にも興味を持て
lines.en: Ren — take an interest in the junior college faculty's research too.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Slight emphasis on 「も」 (the 'also'). Not a suggestion — another task added. Eyes steady, no warmth, no coldness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本学の研究伝統を尊重します
lines.en: Yes. I'll respect our university's research traditions.
lines.style: Slightly more formal now — he's absorbed the broader frame. Nod on the affirmation. Controlled breath. Showing he understands the weight, not just the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究棟の南側に立て看板を出せ
lines.en: Ren — put up a notice board on the south side of the research building.
lines.style: Direct task assignment. Matter-of-fact. No elaboration. Name cues attention, then the order lands without drama. Brief silence before moving on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文データの伝送を暗号化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll encrypt the paper data transmission.
lines.style: Quick, precise confirmation. He's in problem-solving mode now. Brisk rhythm. No hesitation — he sees the implication immediately. Technical confidence showing through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究成果の陳列方法も工夫しろ
lines.en: Ren — be thoughtful about how you display the research outputs.
lines.style: Slightly softer instruction than the others. More like guidance than command. 'Thoughtful' lands with weight. The subtext: this matters beyond compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究不正には懲戒もあると認識します
lines.en: Yes. I understand that research misconduct carries disciplinary action.
lines.style: Formal closing statement. He's reading between the lines now — understanding the warning beneath the instruction. Slow, deliberate. Gravitas. Respectful, not defensive.
